Earnestly. Fiercely enough to burn my brain to ash.

“Um… Ciel?” “You know what my body is like. Nothing can kill me. But the slightest wound could be fatal to you. Your eyes might be capable of defeating Arcueid, but her claws will kill you first.”
“You said you would make me happy. So please—don’t die here.” “But if you face her alone—”

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Um…… Senpai?"
"Tohno-kun, you know about my body, right?
No matter what happens, I won't die.
But a trivial wound could be fatal for you.
Certainly you might be able to defeat Arcueid using your eyes, but before that, she would just shred you apart."
"Tohno-kun, didn't you even say it yourself that you'll make me happy?
So I beg of you, please don't die here."
"But----Senpai, by yourself, you can't----"

「見くびらないでください。
わたし、これでも何十という吸血種を退治してきたんですよ。
こと吸血種に対しての事なら、わたしたちの右にでる者はいないんです」
　自信ありげにシエルはガッツポーズなんかをとったりする。
　……けど。
　彼女の指先が震えているのが見えてしまった。

lines.maoEnglish:
“Don’t underestimate me. I have destroyed dozens of vampiric creatures. When it comes to fighting their kind, no one surpasses us.” Ciel even struck a little victory pose, full of apparent confidence.
And yet I could see her fingertips trembling.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Don't belittle me please.
I've already exterminated scores of vampires before.
When it comes to defeating vampires, there's no one better than me."
She strikes a confident, gutsy pose.
…… But.
I see the tips of her fingers shaking.

恐いのか。

lines.label: s310
lines.maoEnglish: Was she afraid? Even Ciel, who had killed dozens of vampires? No—perhaps precisely because she had killed so many, she understood that the Arcueid we had just seen was anything but ordinary.

「……だめだよ。
先輩、俺はそれでも―――」
　シエルを一人にして、自分だけ逃げるなんて事はしたくない。
　その思いを口にする前に、ぴっ、と俺の口に人差し指を当てて、シエルは言葉をさえぎってしまった。
lines.label: s310
lines.maoEnglish: “No. Even so, I—” I didn’t want to abandon Ciel and save myself. Before I could say it, she touched one finger lightly to my lips and stopped the words.

I don't want to leave Ciel by herself and run away.
Before I can voice that thought, she presses a finger to my lips and stops me.

お願いですから、わたしの我が侭を聞いてください。

そうしないと、わたしは遠野くんに心から笑顔を向けられなくなっちゃうじゃないですか」
　……彼女は瞳に涙をたたえて、そう言った。
lines.label: s310
lines.maoEnglish: “Don’t say the rest. Please indulge my selfishness. Just once—truly, just this once—I want to protect you of my own free will. Otherwise, how could I ever smile at you from the bottom of my heart?” Her eyes brimmed with tears as she spoke.

…… She says that with tears brimming in her eyes.

わたしがこんなに早く帰ってきたのは、駄目だったからなんです」

あそこにあるモノはロアを利用しようっていう方法ばっかりで、転生体である遠野くんを助けようとする方法なんて、なかったんです」
「――――そう、か。
まあ、仕方ないよな。
それは、シエル先輩が、泣くようなことじゃない」
lines.label: s310
lines.maoEnglish: “Tohno… I came back so soon because I failed.” “…” “The Church has no way to save you. Everything they had was about exploiting Roa. There was nothing—nothing meant to save you, his reincarnation vessel.” “I see. Well… it can’t be helped. That isn’t something you should cry over.”

"----I, see.
Oh well, it can't be helped.
It's not something for you to cry about, Ciel-senpai."

lines.maoEnglish: “No…! If I had only been more capable, I’m sure I could have found another way—but I couldn’t! Now all I can do is slow Roa’s encroachment a little. I know how much it hurts. I know exactly how badly you’re suffering, and still all I can think is that I want you to remain with me for as long as possible. I’m so selfish—!”

俺は負けない。

lines.maoEnglish:
“Ciel… I won’t lose. But you’re right that I’m at a disadvantage against Arcueid. So I’ll leave her to you. You’re the seasoned expert on vampires, aren’t you?” “Yes… Thank you.” Ciel’s arms tightened around my back. Holding her, I began to lower my lips to hers.
Ciel promptly sprang away like a startled rabbit.

Then, Ciel hops back like a rabbit.

lines.maoEnglish:
“No kissing. If you did that, I’d be so happy I’d lose my focus completely. For now, let’s stop at holding each other.” “Fair enough. I’ll keep my distance, but call if you’re in trouble. I’ll come at once.”
Ciel nodded without a word. Trusting her, I turned my back.

　アルクェイドに死の要因はない。
　それなら―――その要因をなくしているものを、まず先に――――
　あった。
　遠いか、だがこれ以上は許せない。
lines.label: s310
lines.maoEnglish:
I had been looking at it wrong. Arcueid had no cause of death. Then first I had to destroy whatever was taking that cause away—
There. It was far, but I would permit no more of this.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
I was mistaken.
There are no causes of death on Arcueid.
In that case----first, I have to take that which makes it so----
I found it.
It's far away, but I can't allow any more of this.

「アルクェイド――――！」
　ぴたり、とアルクェイドの手が止まる。
「ついてこい。
そこで、おまえを殺してやる」
　言って、そのまま窓から校庭へと駆け出した。
lines.label: s310
lines.maoEnglish:
“Arcueid!”
Arcueid’s hand stopped. “Follow me. Out there, I’ll kill you.” I leapt through the window and raced toward the schoolyard.

lines.japanese:
―――グラウンドの真ん中か。
　遠い。
間に合うか。
　アルクェイドはタン、と軽い足取りで追ってくる。
　速い。
速いけど、今度ばかりは俺のほうが先をとる―――
lines.label: s310
lines.maoEnglish:
The middle of the athletic field. It was far—could I reach it in time? Arcueid came lightly after me, each step barely touching the ground.
Fast. She was fast, but this once I would get there first—

It's far.

　アルクェイドは一直線に俺へと向かってくる。
　その前に。
　この足元にある一際巨大な『点』、このあたり一帯の世界そのものの『死』を、ナイフで刺した。
lines.label: s310
lines.maoEnglish:

Before she reached me, I drove my knife into the enormous point beneath my feet—the death of the world itself throughout this entire place.

It was done. I had killed the nature in this one area—the source supplying Arcueid with whatever they called vitality.

　ただ、信じられなくて、痛みも衝撃も、何も感じなかった。
　ザン、という音が、今さらになって耳に響いた。
　ドボドボと大量の液体がこぼれていく音。
　見れば。
　アルクェイドの爪は、俺がそれに気がつくより早く、俺の胸を串刺しにしていた。
lines.label: s310
lines.maoEnglish:
“Guh—” Blood surged back up into my mouth.
“What…?” Perhaps she had simply moved too fast. It was so impossible that I felt no pain, no impact—nothing at all.
Only then did the sound of the strike reach my ears, followed by liquid pouring out in torrents. When I looked, Arcueid’s claws had already run me through the chest before I even noticed them.

lines.mirrorMoon:

"Eh……?"

I just couldn't believe it, and I didn't feel pain, or shock, or anything.

The sound of blood pouring forth.
Looking down,
Arcueid's claws pierced through my chest before I even realized it.

　普通の人間なら、間違いなく即死の傷だ。

For an ordinary human, this wound would mean instant death.

Arcueid’s grip tightened. My skull creaked as a fracture spread through it.

lines.maoEnglish:
“No. I can’t do as you ask.” “Why? Do you hate me—do you hate me that much, Shiki?”
Never. I could not say such a thing, not even as a lie—
“Please. I understand how you feel, but forgive him now. All Roa ever wanted was for you to look his way. He returned to life over and over, waiting eagerly for you to come. But he’s human. His life was never meant to stretch on and on like yours.” Yes—ageless immortality lay impossibly far beyond humanity. Roa had believed reincarnation would let him continue forever as himself.
But even that had a limit. His method created only descendants who shared the same past and purpose. It never created another self.

Still speaking cheerfully, Arihiko came over to the bedside.

些細な事は見逃してくれるくせに、本当に見逃してほしい事だけは気がついてしまう。

lines.label: s310

“Oh, Tohno. You’re always like this. You let all the little things pass, yet you notice the one thing I desperately want you to let pass. Perhaps that is one of your virtues. But even so…”
At the end, she looked at me almost resentfully.
“Just this once, I wish you had let it pass.”

lines.japanese:
「夢というものにはね、完全な虚像というものはないんだ。
どのような作り話でも、所詮はその人間が得た知識の延長のものでしかない。
　だから、君がさっき見た夢にだって現実でいうところの真実はある。
　例えば――――」

“No dream is made entirely of illusion. However fanciful the story, it can only grow out of things the dreamer has learned.
So even the dream you just saw contains truths about reality.
For example…”

Take my advice and close your eyes again.

「あのね。
そんなコトは関係ないだろう。
どうせ目を覚ましてしまえば、君はユメを見るなんていう事さえできない、ただの『器官の群』になっちゃうんだよ？

シエルっていう人も可哀想だけどね、君も僕も悲惨なものだったじゃないか。

You’ve done well enough. I feel sorry for Ciel, but you and I have both had miserable lives too.
Don’t you think we’ve earned a dream this sweet?”

lines.japanese:
「そういう事。
今まで廃棄物っぽく底で捨てられてたんだけどね、君が同じところに落ちてきたから声をかけたんだよ。
　あ、でも別に僕は君と別人ってわけじゃないぜ。
　僕らはあくまで一つの名前の棲む現象だからね。
　たとえ君が忘れていたとしても、君はもちろん僕の延長である志貴だ。
ただ僕の場合は君の土台ではあるが過去ではないから、廃棄物っていう事になってしまう。
　ま、そのあたりは難しい話だからおいておこう」
lines.label: s310
lines.maoEnglish:
“Exactly. I’d been discarded at the bottom like a piece of refuse, but then you fell into the same place, so I spoke to you.
That doesn’t mean we’re different people. We’re still a single phenomenon inhabited by one name.
Even if you’ve forgotten, you are Shiki—the life that continued on from me. I’m the foundation you were built upon, but I’m not your past, which leaves me as nothing but refuse.
Still, that gets complicated. Let’s leave it there.”
lines.mao_english:
“Exactly. I’d been discarded at the bottom like a piece of refuse, but then you fell into the same place, so I spoke to you.
That doesn’t mean we’re different people. We’re still a single phenomenon inhabited by one name.
Even if you’ve forgotten, you are Shiki—the life that continued on from me. I’m the foundation you were built upon, but I’m not your past, which leaves me as nothing but refuse.
Still, that gets complicated. Let’s leave it there.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"That's it.
I was cast away until now, but since you fell into the same place, I called out to you.
But, it's not like we're actually separate people.
We are the same existence, after all.
Even if you forgot, you are the Shiki that is the extension of me.
But in my case, I am your foundation but not your past, so I am just trash.
Well, it is difficult to talk about it, so let's just leave it aside."

lines.mirror_moon:
"That's true.
You can either wake up to reality and face the death of your will or you can stay here and dream.
No matter which, there really isn't much of a difference.
If you wake up to reality and die, you wouldn't trouble yourself like this.
If you call that happiness, it probably is many times happier."
----Wha……

lines.japanese:
「……けど、僕は君にユメを見てほしい。
僕らは同じ名前でありながら、見れるユメが違うんだ。
　僕の見るユメはね、たいていはあの日の出来事か、九歳までの出来事だけなんだ。
　それはそれで楽しいのかも知れないけど、そこには志貴の未来がない。
　例えば、大人になって、好きな人が出来て、毎日を忙しく生きていく、といった未来かな」
lines.label: s310
lines.maoEnglish:
“But I want you to dream. We share the same name, yet the dreams available to us are different.
Most of mine are about that day, or about things that happened before I turned nine.
Maybe they’re pleasant in their own way, but there’s no future for Shiki in them.
No growing up, falling in love, or spending your days busy with living.”

lines.japanese:
「僕の現実、僕が知り得た知識、そこから想像できるであろう未来は、とても狭くて救われないものばかりだから、そういったものを想像する事さえできない。
　けど君のユメは違った。
君にとっては当たり前の風景も、僕にとってみれば輝かしい風景なんだ。
それこそ夢にまで見たっていうヤツだよ。
　……もっとも狭量な僕の年月では君のようなユメは思い浮かばないんだけどね」
lines.label: s310
lines.maoEnglish:
“My reality, everything I ever learned, and every future I can imagine from them are narrow and hopeless. I can’t even picture a life like that.
But your dreams were different. Scenes that were ordinary to you shone brilliantly to me. They were, quite literally, the stuff of my dreams.
Though my little lifetime was too cramped to invent dreams like yours on its own.”

…… But with my limited years, I can't even think of your dreams by myself."

----………

「……気が乗らないみたいだね。
やっぱり冷めてしまうと目を覚まそうとしてしまうものなのかな。

たしかにユメに見る現実なんて、本当の現実に比べるべくもないものだけどさ。
　それでも―――頑張れば、少しぐらいは幸せになれるじゃないか」

But your reality is already over. Of course a dreamed reality can’t compare with the real thing.
Even so… if you try, you could find a little happiness here.”
No… The only people who would be happy there are us, Shiki.

lines.japanese:
「………馬鹿だな。
幸福なんて、自分だけのモノにしておけば簡単なのに。
他人の事まで考えるとね、色々と難しくなっていくんだよ。
　その結果、なにが良くて何が悪かったのかなんて事さえ難しくてわからなくなる。
　事実、僕も君も何一つだって悪い事はしなかった。
なのに結果はこうだろう？
　ほら、志貴はそういう人間なんだ。
奪われてばかりの人生だから、誰かの幸福なんて欲しがっちゃいけないんだよ」
lines.label: s310
lines.maoEnglish:
“You idiot. Happiness is easy if you keep it all for yourself. The moment you include other people, everything becomes complicated.
Soon even deciding what was right and what was wrong becomes too difficult.
The truth is, neither of us did anything wrong. And this is still how it ended.
That’s the kind of person Shiki is. When life has done nothing but take from you, you have no business reaching for someone else’s happiness.”

That’s the kind of person Shiki is. When life has done nothing but take from you, you have no business reaching for someone else’s happiness.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"………… You are stupid.
It's simple to be happy by yourself.
If you start to think about others, it gets much more difficult.
As a result, even what's good or bad becomes too difficult to figure out.
And in reality, you and I never did anything wrong.
But this is how we ended up, right?
See, that's the person you are Shiki.
You've only had things stolen from you, so you shouldn't worry about making others happy."
